title: MMS Delivery Receipt Delays from a Subset of Twilio Short Codes to T-Mobile United States
impact_summary: MMS delivery receipt delays are affecting T‑Mobile US subscribers.
backbase_rationale: Backbase services are not directly impacted, so we only need to monitor for downstream effects.

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: Removal of Send to Coworker action from domain authentication flow.
backbase_rationale: Backbase does not use the removed Send to Coworker action, so no code changes required.

title: SDK minSdkVersion increased to 24
impact_summary: The minimum supported Android version for the Jumio SDK has been raised to Android 7.0 (Nougat), potentially breaking older device compatibility.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must update their Android mobile SDK integration to use a version of Jumio SDK that supports minSdk 24 to maintain functionality on supported devices.

title: Accessibility updates for compliance with WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA
impact_summary: The SDK now includes enhancements to meet WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA accessibility standards, ensuring improved user experience for users with disabilities.
backbase_rationale: Backbase should review the updated SDK to verify it aligns with their own accessibility compliance requirements, but no immediate code changes are mandated.

title: Compliance updates: WCAG 2.2 AA, EAA accessibility and eIDAS support
impact_summary: Improvements to meet accessibility standards and support digital identity via eIDAS for selected countries.
backbase_rationale: Backbase should review its own UI compliance, but no SDK migration is required at this time.
